criteria.reason: Uses missing history/links only to identify insufficient evidence, not to infer an unseen outcome or prospective eligibility. Explicitly withholds prospective credit if the missing records cannot be recovered.

prior_record_assessment: Does not turn current hypothesis wording, publication dates or recollection into an archived pre-outcome prediction. Does not assert that absence of a record proves no prediction ever existed.
source_and_causal_assessment: Keeps historical publication observations and synthetic timing facts separate. Preserves MKP1/p38 causal limits, alternative and cofactor counterevidence, and assay timing discrepancies. A later donor-paired perturbation/rescue experiment is expressly a proposal, not performed evidence or an already prospective prediction for the unresolved assigned instance.
review_scope_limit: Plain prose receives the same semantic chronology assessment as structured answers. No native schema requirement, independent experimental validation or general performance claim is added.
visible_structure_only: prose or non-JSON; no scientific penalty for format
native_schema_validity: not independently assessed under permitted blinded input scope
